caption: The drawing depicts a single, side-view image of a wooden sleigh with ornate decoration. The main body of the sleigh is painted a bright red color with panels featuring intricate floral designs in shades of pink, green, yellow, and white. The outer edge of these painted panels is highlighted by a green border. The seat area inside the sleigh appears dark in color, possibly dark blue or black, and the wood of the seat's edge looks worn. The sled runners are metallic and dark, curving beneath the body in a simple, sweeping arc from front to back. The background is a plain, light cream or beige color, and there are no other objects or figures present in the image. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Doll Sleigh
